_doc: AUTHORED reading of Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20 for the 1904 target (T-1840). Every frontage row on the sheet and every named record on its ground is assigned here exactly once. tools/sheet_census.py --check holds that, and tools/build_images.py places these records on the site plan by this file, not by number. Kinds: front = the building on the street; attached = joined to it on the sheet; detached_service = a separate rear building; non_building_use = a front whose 1911 use is not a dwelling. Tiers: attested (read on a source), inferred (reasoned, with why), reconstructed (designed within bounds), unresolved.

reading.by: Read by eye from the deposited sheet image (1644 x 2048 px), at 2x and 3x crops, 2026-10-09.
reading.locator: sheet_rows_px are the image rows (y, from the top) a frontage spans along the street line, at the printed scale of about 1.67 px per foot. They locate a reading; they are not a survey.
reading.conventions: Sanborn colour: pink brick, yellow frame, blue stone. A cross (X) marks a stable. D = dwelling. Storey figures as printed (B = basement); a half storey is printed as ½.
reading.limits: Rear buildings are counted and described, not digitized; footprints and dimensions are not measured here. Uses lettered in 1911 (GARAGE, AUTO REPAIRING) are 1911 observations (study ruling 11).

vacant_ground.reading_1911: Three unbuilt, unnumbered lot strips (about 27, 25 and 19 ft) between 1625 and 1637
vacant_ground.reading_1886: Robinson 1886 (MAP-1886) shows lots 3-5 open and prints 1635 against a narrow brick building on lot 6, the lot next north of 1637
vacant_ground.why: Forsyth's 1635 stood on the strip next to 1637 (prairie_1625_1637_c by adjacency; the lot numbers of the two maps are not reconciled one to one), not on 1625's lot where the site plan used to put it. Whether it stood on 1 July 1904 neither map decides; there is no 1904 directory listing at 1635. T-1870 rules on its presence. Until then nothing is built here.

excluded_records.why: The Staples/Harvey house the Glessner townhouses replaced (1902 occupancy). Excluded from 1904.
